memo.headline: AI Inference shows latent standalone demand but weak revenue share and win rate, so diagnose the losses before investing as its own category.
memo.evidence: Demand signals are positive: standalone demand share is 22.0%, 72.7% of standalone mentions are buyer-initiated, and standalone win rate is 40.0% on 10 closed deals. Usage lags: standalone revenue share is 20.0% against a 25.0% effective threshold, which is the sensitive check. Self-serve paid conversion within the 90-day paid window is 12.2% without voice and 23.8% with voice. Standalone 12-month retention is 80.7% (n=31) versus 72.2% attached (n=18). Samples are small and the data is synthetic. A higher standalone win rate or usage share would change the call.
